name: Tahlia Tucker
title: Psychologist
description: Tahlia has experience using CBT, ACT, Internal Family Systems (IFS), Schema Therapy, and eating disorder specific interventions such as Family Based Treatment (FBT) and SSCM. Works at both Ringwood and Forest Hill clinics.

name: Sunny Parker
title: Psychologist
description: Sunny draws upon ACT, CBT and Schema-informed practice. She is particularly passionate about supporting clients struggling with adjustment and life transition, identity, self-esteem, depression, anxiety, relationship issues, intimate partner violence, and trauma-related disorders. Works at the Forest Hill clinic.
specialties: Schema-informed, Trauma, Identity, Intimate partner violence

name: Dr Rui Ying 'Ying' Yew
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Ying works with adults (18+) and her areas of interest include mood and anxiety disorders, stress and adjustment difficulties, low self-esteem, perfectionism, trauma, disordered eating, and relationship difficulties. She draws on CBT, ACT, DBT, Schema Therapy, and Motivational Interviewing. Works at the Ringwood clinic.
specialties: Trauma, Schema Therapy, Disordered eating, Perfectionism

name: Oliver Waluk
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Oliver's psychological areas of interest include depression, anxiety, complex-trauma, and grief. Works at the Ringwood clinic.

name: Nikki Bleja
title: Psychologist (Counselling)
description: Nikki has experience and an interest in assisting clients with issues relating to trauma, depression and anxiety, grief, identity, relationship difficulties, stress, ADHD, and cross-cultural adjustment. Works at the Ringwood clinic.

name: Sandra Fawcett
title: Psychologist
description: Sandra has special interests in personality disorders, trauma, interpersonal issues, and early parenting. Works at the Ringwood clinic and via telehealth.

name: Lisa Diaz
title: Psychologist
description: Lisa has experience working with depression, anxiety, adjustment disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, work-related stress, relationship conflict/breakdown, and grief and loss. Works at the Ringwood clinic.
